Roborock S7 replacement parts.

For the original Roborock S7 robot vacuum and mop. This guide links verified Amazon listings for its washable filter and brushes; the official S7-compatible VibraRise mop cloth is linked in the buying notes.

Check the variant: This guide covers the original S7 robot. S7+ adds an optional auto-empty dock; the standard S7 does not use disposable dock bags. S7 MaxV, S7 Max Ultra and S7 Pro Ultra are separate variants, so do not assume their complete kits or dock parts fit. The selected White - 04 variation of the Amazon S7 robot listing was unavailable when checked; offers and variants can change.

Roborock S7 replacement filters

Two white washable filters in the selected Filter-A variation.

View replacement filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: Roborock's Amazon listing explicitly names the original S7 among its compatible models.

Replace when: Roborock says to replace the washable filter every 6–12 months, or sooner if it is damaged or remains clogged after cleaning.

Before buying: This filter fits the robot dustbin, not an optional dock. Rinse it gently and let it air-dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling; check that the selected option is Filter-A, the two-piece white pack.

Fit: The selected Amazon variation names the Roborock S7; the listing also names several related models.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Original S7 vs. S7+
The S7+ package adds an auto-empty dock to the S7 robot. These three cards cover robot-mounted consumables. Do not buy disposable dock bags unless your setup has a compatible auto-empty dock.
S7 vs. S7 MaxV, S7 Max Ultra and S7 Pro Ultra
Some Amazon listings group several S7 names together, but that does not prove that every filter, brush or dock part is shared. Each linked listing above names the original S7, and the selected pack is described on its card.
VibraRise mop cloth
Roborock's official two-piece mop-cloth page lists the S7 as compatible. Use that product page to check the cloth if you need one; this guide does not link an Amazon mop-cloth card because a same-listing Amazon photo could not be verified.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock S7 maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock S7 cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Washable robot-bin filterEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Rubber main rollerEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months
VibraRise mop clothAfter each useEvery 3–6 months

A washable filter needs at least 24 hours to air-dry after rinsing. Clear hair from both ends of the roller before replacing it, and remove and wash the VibraRise cloth after mopping. Wear and use can change replacement timing.

Before you order

How often should I replace Roborock S7 filters and brushes?

Roborock recommends replacing the washable filter and main roller every 6–12 months, and the side brush every 3–6 months. Clean the filter and roller every two weeks and the side brush monthly. Replace a part sooner if it is damaged or no longer works properly.

Which Roborock S7 mop cloth fits?

Roborock's official two-piece replacement cloth page names the S7. Open the Roborock mop-cloth source below and confirm the product details; this guide does not present an Amazon cloth card without a verified same-listing photo.

Does the standard Roborock S7 use dust bags?

No. The standard S7 uses its robot dustbin. The S7+ bundle includes an auto-empty dock; buy dock bags only if you have that compatible dock, and check the dock model separately.

Are the linked Roborock S7 replacement parts all genuine?

The washable filters and side brushes are Roborock-branded Amazon listings. The three-roller PELLYDA brush is a third-party replacement. The cards identify each listing's brand and pack; confirm the selected variation before ordering.
